tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The areeba red. Primary buttons, active tab, selected states, key brand moments. One primary action per screen.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind brand content: selected rows, highlighted chips, onboarding panels.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (4.6:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The deep navy identity colour. Card faces, hero panels, SaaS sidebar.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on night surfaces.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Secondary highlight tint for illustrations, empty states and marketing accents. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default app background (mobile) and content panels (SaaS).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: SaaS page canvas behind cards; grouped list backgrounds on mobile.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus and dialogs. Pair with a shadow token in light, with line in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast; never use for information.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 against surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element. Blue so it never reads as an error on red brand fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Money in, completed payments, verified states. Text-safe on surface.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, expiring, needs attention. Text-safe on surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, declined, destructive. Darker than brand and always paired with an icon or word so it is never confused with the brand red.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger badges and alerts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system information and links inside alerts.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series, always: your own business or the metric the chart is about. Assign chart-1→4 in fixed order; never cycle or reuse for status.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (comparison period, second channel).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series. A fifth series folds into 'Other' or small multiples. The four are validated for colour-blind separation in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the baseline: recessive, decorative only.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and SaaS empty-state headlines.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding screens and dashboard page titles on desktop.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Default body on mobile (matches iOS/Android reading size).
styles.sample: Your transfer is on its way and should arrive within minutes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body in SaaS, secondary body on mobile.
styles.sample: Settlements are processed every business day at 18:00.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: Account balance hero. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in lists and tables, right-aligned, tabular.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, API keys, references, card BIN/last-4 in SaaS.

spacing.note: A 4px base grid. Mobile screens use space-4 (16) side gutters; SaaS content uses space-6 (24) to space-8 (32).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related elements: label and field, icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips, list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen gutter, card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (md/lg).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: SaaS card padding and gutters, gap between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: SaaS page top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major vertical rhythm on marketing and empty states.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tiny tags, table cell highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs in dense SaaS tables, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, list groups, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, payment cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, switches, segmented tabs.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and list groups.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the mobile tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

size.note: Control heights. Anything tappable on mobile is at least size-control-lg (48) or has a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense SaaS toolbars and table actions only. Never on mobile.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default SaaS buttons and fields.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Default mobile buttons and fields.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Standard icon box (20px glyph on a 24px grid, 1.75px stroke).

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar height, excluding the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones in landscape; single column ends.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets; mobile tab bar becomes a side rail.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: SaaS layout with fixed sidebar.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Max content width for SaaS dashboards.
